answer_1.quote: Given an input word problem description, the MWP solver needs to understand the problem in natural language, figure out the mathematical logic underlying the problem, then formulate the corresponding solution expression by employing suitable mathematical operation symbols (e.g., +, -, ×, /) to link the relevant numbers in the problem.
answer_1.outputs: Mathematical expressions represented as unified MTree structures
